items.title: TRiCares Presents Positive Topaz Primary Endpoints from the TRICURE EU Pivotal Study at PCR London Valves
items.title_zh: PCR London Valves 2026:TRiCares公布经导管三尖瓣置换系统Topaz欧洲关键性研究TRICURE EU主要终点积极结果
items.summary_zh: 德国/比利时器械公司TRiCares于2026年11月23日在PCR London Valves大会Top Late-Breaking Trials专场公布其双支架结构(柔性外支架+刚性内支架)经导管三尖瓣置换系统Topaz在欧洲关键性研究TRICURE EU中的30天结果:主要有效性终点——三尖瓣反流较基线降低≥1个等级且术后不超过中度——达标率为98%;安全性方面复合主要不良事件发生率低,新发永久起搏器植入率为5%。公司表示结果支持其CE认证申请推进,但这是企业自行公布的topline数据,尚未经独立同行评议发表,完整入组人数、人群特征及更长期随访结果仍待公开。
items.summary_en: German/Belgian device company TRiCares announced on November 23, 2026, in a Top Late-Breaking Trials session at PCR London Valves, that its dual-stent (compliant outer frame, rigid inner frame) transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement system, Topaz, met its 30-day primary performance endpoint — tricuspid regurgitation reduced by at least one grade to no more than moderate — in 98% of patients in the European TRICURE EU pivotal study. The composite major-adverse-event rate was low, with a 5% new permanent pacemaker implantation rate. The company says the results support its path toward CE marking, but these are company-reported topline figures, not yet independently peer-reviewed, and full cohort size, baseline characteristics and longer-term follow-up have not yet been published.
